overview.title: About this project
overview.intro: A personal space for writing, reference material, videos, outdoor trips, and shared conversation.
overview.accountDescription: Learn how account trust levels shape participation.
overview.sectionsDescription: Choose a section to read, watch, follow trips, or join the conversation.

accountLevels.title: Account levels
accountLevels.intro: Account trust levels describe participation permissions. They are separate from the administrator role.

new.title: New
new.description: New accounts can read public content while verification is still required for participation.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Verified accounts can participate in supported social and outdoor actions. They can have up to 3 trips, 30 photos, and 10 tracks at one time.

trusted.title: Trusted
trusted.description: Trusted accounts keep ordinary participation capabilities without the verified-account resource limits. Eligible verified accounts can be promoted through positive activity on the site.

restricted.title: Restricted
restricted.description: Restricted accounts can read public content but cannot use trust-gated participation actions.

accountLevels.roleTitle: Trust level and role are different
accountLevels.roleDescription: Trust levels describe ordinary account participation. Administrator access is a separate role and is not assigned by this guide.
